course_access_source_valid.name: course_access_source_valid
course_access_source_valid.value: ("course_access"."source_purchase_id" IS NOT NULL AND "course_access"."granted_by" IS NULL) OR ("course_access"."source_purchase_id" IS NULL AND "course_access"."granted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "course_access"."grant_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("course_access"."grant_reason")) > 0)

course_access_revocation_reason.name: course_access_revocation_reason
course_access_revocation_reason.value: "course_access"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR ("course_access"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("course_access"."revocation_reason")) > 0)

video_ready_identifiers.name: video_ready_identifiers
video_ready_identifiers.value: "video_assets"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("video_assets"."mux_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "video_assets"."signed_playback_id" IS NOT NULL)
